tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Get usage summary, billing events, and prepaid credit balance for a time period. Returns itemized events (scans, forwards, mail sends) with costs, period totals, and credits. Defaults to the current billing period if no dates are specified. Use this in Cursor/MCP chat when the human asks how many ma

tools.name: list_inbound_forwarding_addresses
tools.description: List the renter’s private inbound forwarding aliases on forward.mailbox.bot. These are the unique intake email addresses an operator, assistant, provider, or external agent can forward scans, PDFs, photos, provider notices, notes, and other context-aware documents to so mailbox.bot can build OCR-bac

tools.name: list_inbound_mail
tools.description: List forwarded inbound mail items captured from private forwarding aliases. Default output includes compact draft_context so an LLM or external agent can reason about OCR context, reply contact candidates, deadlines, and thread linkage before generating outbound mail.

tools.name: get_inbound_mail
tools.description: Get one forwarded inbound mail item with compact draft_context by default. Use this before drafting an outbound reply when you need sender context, reply contact candidates, deadline clues, source files, and thread linkage in one stable payload.

tools.name: list_postal_threads
tools.description: List physical-mail threads that group inbound mail context, human review, and outbound sends. Use this to understand which inbound items and outbound documents belong to the same business workflow.

tools.name: get_postal_thread
tools.description: Get one physical-mail thread with optional timeline events. Use this to explain how a generated outbound mail piece relates back to prior inbound scans and review decisions.

tools.name: get_mailbox_md
tools.description: Get the renter's MAILBOX.md standing instructions for this agent. Returns the full instruction text, version number, content hash, and last update timestamp. Call this on startup and cache the version — you must pass it to send_outbound_mail for sync verification.

tools.name: propose_mailbox_md_edit
tools.description: Propose changes to the renter's MAILBOX.md instructions with reasoning. The renter will see your suggestion in their dashboard and can accept, reject, or modify it. Use this when you observe patterns that could be codified into standing instructions.

tools.name: send_facility_message
tools.description: Send a message to the Austin HQ operator managing your mailbox. Facility routing is automatic. Messages appear in the shared conversation visible to you, the renter, and the facility. Optionally link the message to a specific package or action request for context.

tools.name: list_facility_conversations
tools.description: List your Austin HQ conversation with its unread message count and last message preview. Facility routing is automatic.

tools.name: get_facility_messages
tools.description: Read the message thread with Austin HQ. Facility routing is automatic. Returns messages in reverse chronological order with sender role (member, facility, agent). Supports cursor-based pagination. Automatically marks facility messages as read.

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.description: Configure webhook endpoint URL and event subscriptions for real-time notifications. Outbound events are mail.pending_approval, mail.submitted, mail.ready, mail.mailed, mail.delivered, mail.failed, and mail.cancelled. Canonical physical-custody events are inbound.received and inbound.scan_available.

tools.name: send_outbound_mail
tools.description: Submit a document for printing and postal mailing by the facility. Supported formats: PDF, DOCX, JPG, PNG, TXT, CSV. tools.description: List outbound mail jobs with status tracking. Returns mail ID, recipient, mail class, status, cost, timestamps, and failure metadata. Filter by status, created_at date range, or search recipient/address/tracking/agent notes.

tools.name: get_outbound_mail

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "send_outbound_mail" is 2240 chars, far longer than this server's median (268). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_usage, list_inbound_forwarding_addresses, list_inbound_mail, get_inbound_mail, list_postal_threads, get_postal_thread, list_facility_conversations, get_facility_messages, get_outbound_mail · Private data: get_mailbox, list_inbound_forwarding_addresses, list_inbound_mail, get_inbound_mail, list_postal_threads, send_outbound_mail, get_outbound_mail, create_test_outbound_mail, advance_test_outbound_mail · Public sink: list_inbound_forwarding_addresses, send_facility_message, update_webhook, send_outbound_mail, create_test_outbound_mail, advance_test_outbound_mail · Destructive: propose_mailbox_md_edit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_usage, list_inbound_forwarding_addresses, list_inbound_mail, get_inbound_mail, list_postal_threads, get_postal_thread, list_facility_conversations, get_facility_messages, get_outbound_mail · Private data: get_mailbox, list_inbound_forwarding_addresses, list_inbound_mail, get_inbound_mail, list_postal_threads, send_outbound_mail, get_outbound_mail, create_test_outbound_mail, advance_test_outbound_mail · Public sink: list_inbound_forwarding_addresses, send_facility_message, update_webhook, send_outbound_mail, create_test_outbound_mail, advance_test_outbound_mail · Destructive: propose_mailbox_md_edit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
